name: securechain-demo
description: A curated, exact-count manifest: 2 Critical, 2 High, 2 Medium (real CVEs, verified via GitHub Advisory/NVD), and 5 Unverified (no catalogued CVE). Of the 5 Unverified, canvas genuinely resolves to High via the static-scan path (real install-time script + child_process, verified live against the real package) and the remaining 4 resolve to Safe. No Low-severity (0.1-3.9) or 3rd-Critical entry is included: no real, version-verified CVE at that tier was available without a GITHUB_TOKEN in this environment (NVD's keyword-only fallback produced unreliable matches when checked), and unverified data was deliberately excluded rather than used. Edit a dependency's version to the fixed version named in its Recommendation tab, or run securechain accept to record a deliberate exception, then push again.
